doc.title: Bill Charlap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000

title: The full toolbox of knowledge behind improvisation
summary: Scale, rhythmic and historical knowledge are all needed to build the house.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Do you have to go through a certain amount of technical chordal scale knowledge to get to that point?
Scale knowledge. Rhythmic knowledge. Historical knowledge. Everything. Absolutely. Absolutely. You have to have a full tool box or you won’t be able to build the house.
